saw_lines: Practice managers rarely switch billing partners over price. They stay for years and move when denials or slow payments force it.
So practices pick the firm that proves it can fix denials, and that proof must reach them before the first call.
Your 150 Google creatives run in 40 image formats, so test three short videos that walk through a free billing review, the offer your homepage already leads with.
ads_1: Paid Google direction: a free billing review offer in short video and image formats
